title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request bearer resource allocation.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by MME to reject bearer resource allocation request.

entities.name: linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: IE included in BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message identifying the linked EPS bearer.

entities.name: ESM cause #43
entities.description: Invalid EPS bearer identity cause value used in BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message.

entities.name: ESM cause #31
entities.description: Request rejected, unspecified cause value used in BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message.

entities.name: No PDN connection with linked EPS bearer identity activated
entities.description: Abnormal case where linked EPS bearer identity does not belong to default EPS bearer context of established PDN connection.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST for emergency PDN connection
entities.description: Abnormal case where request is received for PDN connection established for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: MME rejects bearer resource allocation
entities.description: MME behavior to reply with BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message in abnormal cases.

relations.description: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message contains linked EPS bearer identity IE.
Condition of no PDN connection with linked EPS bearer identity triggers MME reject behavior.
Condition of request for emergency PDN connection triggers MME reject behavior.
MME reject behavior results in sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message uses ESM cause #43 for no PDN connection condition.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message uses ESM cause #31 for emergency PDN connection condition.
